plan.close_all: Royal-army floor stays at 8,500 account equity (free equity + collateral + unrealized): flatten every layer immediately if equity touches 8,500; current equity is about 8,982 so the cushion is only about 480, which is why RP has been shrunk. Weekly loss cap: if realized + unrealized for the week reaches -300 USD (about 13% of one army, equity about 8,680), flatten everything and stop hunting until next week (wait and see). Directional structure stops: a BTC daily close below 72,500 closes all long layers (new lower box, floor tactic dead); a BTC daily close above 79,500 closes all short layers (back inside the old box, EMA cluster reclaimed). Otherwise no forced liquidation: at week end, if the week is net positive by more than +60 USD, close all winners to bank the hostages and carry only layers still within their 12% RP stop into next week under the same RP.
plan.hostage_policy: Resources shrank from 10,000 to about 8,982, so the RP is redesigned, not just carried: four armies of 2,245 collateral each (reallocation), fixed notional 5,000 per layer (2.2x, inside the max leverage of every watchlist symbol, BNB 10 being the lowest), hard stop at 12% of collateral (about 270 USD, roughly 5.4% price) as the only stop. Never add size to a losing layer, never martingale, never tighten a stop to free margin, never hedge the same symbol, one layer per symbol. Max 2 layers open at once and max 1 hostage: a layer underwater by more than 5% of collateral (about 112 USD) is a hostage; while one hostage exists only one more army may hunt, preferably on a different symbol and at the opposite range edge (a short hostage is released by a long hunt at a floor and vice versa); if a second layer becomes a hostage, stop all new entries and wait and see until one is released or stopped. Path D release: when a hunting army closes a win such that win + hostage unrealized >= 0, close the hostage at market to free the slot; if a hostage recovers to breakeven plus fees while the slot is needed, release it and re-enter only at a fresh zone. A symbol that hits its 12% RP stop is frozen in that direction until a 4h reclaim of its zone plus BTC daily above 76,300. Weekly realized loss of -300 ends hunting for the week. Profits stay in the main port as buffer; no Step 2 Big-Win bets until buffer exceeds 10% of collateral (about +225), which is not the case this week.
plan.rationale: Last week the four-army box tactic banked SOL +218 and BTC +108, released the BNB hostage via Path D at -240, but the ETH long became a second hostage and had to be closed at the RP stop (-553) when the whole market broke its 10/30 floors, leaving the week about -470 and equity near 8,982, only about 480 above the 8,500 royal-army floor. Per the Hostage Hunt design, when resources shrink the general shrinks the armies rather than quitting: reallocation gives 2,245 per army, and leverage is cut from 4x to 2.2x (notional 5,000) with the hard stop tightened to 12% of collateral (about 270 USD, 5.4% price) so that two sequential stop-outs plus the -300 weekly loss cap still cannot breach the floor. Market regime: BTC 75.0k closed 74,821 after a 73,457 wick, below EMA20 78.5k and EMA50 79.5k with RSI 35, MACD negative and widening; ETH, SOL, XRP all broke their 10/30 lows (RSI 27-33) and sit on weekly support shelves; BNB is the only relative-strength major. Directional prediction is low-edge, but two-sided volatility (ATR 3% BTC, 4.7-5.4% alts) at freshly defined range edges (old floors now ceilings, weekly shelves below) is enough to harvest small hostages of +1.5% to +4% price (+75 to +200 USD per layer). Flow is down, so shorts into old-floor retests are the primary hunt and longs are only taken on wick flushes into weekly shelves with 4h reclaims (Zero Alpha: enter where the crowd is not positioned, at the edges, never mid-box). Control Risk: 8,500 floor, -300 weekly cap, BTC daily structure closes. Limit Resources: fixed 2,245/5,000 RP, max 2 open layers, max 1 hostage, one layer per symbol, XRP/BNB share a slot. Wait and See: 4h confirmation at every zone, frozen re-entry after a stop. Goal is Step 1 only: survive and rebuild the buffer toward 9,200 before any Big-Win attempt.
